notes: TVA 18% (CGI art. 241, official 2025 text). The art. 229 exemption list and art. 230 zero-rate (exports only) contain no gold or precious metals, so bullion takes 18%. Import duty (ECOWAS CET, Douanes tariff SH2022): 5% on unwrought/powder gold, 10% on ingots and other semi-manufactured forms - the 10% ingot rate is coded for gold.

sources.name: Ministère des Finances (finances.bj) - Code Général des Impôts 2025
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 241 fixes the TVA rate at 18%; the art. 229 exemptions and art. 230 zero rates contain no gold or precious-metals item
sources.quote: Article 241 : Le taux de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée est fixé à 18%.
